steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0059_bar_locked_gaba_ampa_sweep_t0057 branch from main and write step_tracker.json.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0009, t0011, t0012, t0057 are completed.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the mandatory task folder structure including assets/library/ for the expected library asset.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: prior literature surveys (t0017 patch-clamp, t0018 synaptic integration, t0027 morphology DS modeling) and the brainstorm-11 specification supply the literature context for bar-arrival-locked SAC inhibition and AMPA escape; no new paper research is needed.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: NEURON MOD file syntax and the bar-arrival-locked timing formula are well-established from t0057's gaba_tonic.mod implementation; task is implementation-focused with explicit specification.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0057 (parent task with same morphology, placement, E-mechanism, AIS, HH, and gaba_tonic.mod; bar-arrival-locked window mechanism and EPSP_PASSIVE/IPSP_PASSIVE protocol fix replace the global window and legacy mode trio respectively), t0011 visualisation library, and t0012 scoring library to identify direct reuse and the swap surface.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesize research-code into plan/plan.md with concrete code design for the per-synapse bar-arrival-locked window mechanism, EPSP_PASSIVE/IPSP_PASSIVE save-and-zero protocol, the 5x5 (gAMPA, GABA_BASE_NS) sweep harness, and the cross-grid heatmap plotting pipeline.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Skipped: task runs on local CPU only ($0 budget).

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Build the minimal_dsgc_bar_locked_gaba_ampa_sweep library asset with per-synapse bar-arrival-locked GABA windows and the corrected EPSP_PASSIVE/IPSP_PASSIVE/FULL protocol; run 12 directions x 10 trials x 3 modes x 25 (gAMPA, GABA_BASE_NS) grid cells = 9000 trials; produce per-direction plots and metrics for each grid cell, plus cross-grid heatmap summary plots.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Skipped: no remote machines were used.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: task design is fully specified by brainstorm 11; the 5x5 sweep grid and reporting structure leave no room for exploratory analysis at this stage.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json (multi-variant, one variant per (gAMPA, GABA_BASE_NS) grid cell), costs.json, remote_machines_used.json; embed cross-grid heatmaps and selected per-grid-cell representatives.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare grid-cell DSI, peak rate, HWHM, and tuning shape against t0057 (parent), t0052/t0053/t0054/t0055 (siblings), and published DSGC benchmarks (Park 2014, Poleg-Polsky 2016, de Rosenroll 2026).

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up suggestions covering propagation of the bar-locked GABA + corrected protocol back to t0054 (NMDA architecture) and t0052 (scalar gabaMOD), any operating-point insights from the 5x5 sweep, and active-dendrite (RQ4) or g_Na/g_K (RQ1) follow-ups depending on outcome.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, set status=completed, push branch, open PR, run pre-merge verificator, merge.
